action:
After a standard system update you need to restart MiniSSDPd to make all
the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that MiniSSDPd incorrectly handled device updates under
certain circumstances, leading to a use-after-free. A remote attacker could
possibly use this issue to cause MiniSSDPd to crash, resulting in a denial
of service.
isummary:
MiniSSDPd could be made to crash if it received specially crafted network
traffic.

minissdpd.description: keep memory of all UPnP devices that announced themselves
